name: special_shifted_chebyshev_polynomial_t
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::special_shifted_chebyshev_polynomial_t(Tensor x, Tensor n) -> Tensor. The correctness suite covers integer tensor degrees through the registered default overload, Python integer degrees through the exported FlagGems callable and ATen n_scalar reference, float32/float64 inputs in [0, 1], and rejection of Half/BFloat16 by the wrapper. The operation does not mutate or alias either input.
